components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The standard cobalt action for creating or saving a record.
components.css: .ds-primary-button { align-items: center; background: var(--cobalt, #174fc9); border: 0; border-radius: 0; color: white; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; font-family: "Archivo Variable", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-weight: 650; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; } .ds-primary-button:hover { background: var(--cobalt-dark, #103b95); } .ds-primary-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--amber, #d87818); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-primary-button:active { background: var(--cobalt-dark, #103b95); } .ds-primary-button:disabled { background: #708186; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: The square ledger field used for names, models, prompts, and messages.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-agent-name">Agent name</label><input class="ds-field" id="ds-agent-name" placeholder="Evidence checker" />
components.css: .ds-field-label { color: var(--ink-soft, #52656a); display: block; font-family: "Archivo Variable", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: .06em; margin-bottom: 7px; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field { background: var(--paper-bright, #f8fbfa); border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #8ba0a5); border-radius: 0; color: var(--ink, #13262d); font-family: "Archivo Variable", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; height: 45px; outline: 0; padding: 12px 13px; width: 100%; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: var(--ink-soft, #52656a); opacity: 1; } .ds-field:hover { border-color: var(--ink-soft, #52656a); } .ds-field:focus { border-color: var(--cobalt, #174fc9); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--cobalt-soft, #dbe6ff); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--amber, #d87818); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Primary Navigation Link
components.description: A full-height header link with a cobalt active register mark.
components.html: ChatsAgents
components.css: .ds-primary-nav { align-items: stretch; background: var(--ink, #13262d); display: flex; gap: 4px; height: 74px; } .ds-nav-link { align-items: center; color: #bdcaca; display: flex; font-family: "Archivo Variable", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-weight: 560; padding: 0 20px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link::after { background: transparent; bottom: 0; content: ""; height: 3px; left: 20px; position: absolute; right: 20px; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link:active, .ds-nav-link.ds-active { color: white; } .ds-nav-link.ds-active::after { background: #8fb0ff; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--amber, #d87818); outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Active Room Record
components.description: The selected room is a lifted ledger row, not a rounded card.
components.html: Research review12 messages
components.css: .ds-room-record { align-items: flex-start; color: var(--ink, #13262d); display: flex; gap: 9px; padding: 13px 10px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-room-record:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .55); } .ds-room-record.ds-active { background: var(--paper-bright, #f8fbfa); box-shadow: 0 7px 19px rgba(45, 63, 68, .08); } .ds-room-record:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--amber, #d87818); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-room-signal { border: 2px solid var(--rule-strong, #8ba0a5); border-radius: 50%; height: 10px; margin-top: 4px; width: 10px; } .ds-active .ds-room-signal { border-color: var(--cobalt, #174fc9); } .ds-room-copy { display: grid; font-family: "Archivo Variable", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; gap: 5px; } .ds-room-copy small { color: var(--ink-soft, #52656a); font-size: 11px; }

components.name: Numbered Agent Sequence
components.description: The signature rail exposes ordered evaluation and explicit status.
components.css: .ds-sequence-row { color: var(--ink, #13262d); display: grid; font-family: "Archivo Variable", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; grid-template-columns: 29px minmax(0, 1fr); min-height: 74px; } .ds-sequence-rail { align-items: center; display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-sequence-rail span { align-items: center; background: var(--paper-bright, #f8fbfa); border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #8ba0a5); border-radius: 50%; display: flex; font-size: 10px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; height: 24px; justify-content: center; width: 24px; } .ds-sequence-rail i { background: var(--rule-strong, #8ba0a5); flex: 1; width: 1px; } .ds-sequence-copy { display: grid; gap: 3px; padding: 3px 6px 16px 8px; } .ds-sequence-copy code { color: var(--ink-soft, #52656a); font-family: inherit; font-size: 10px; } .ds-sequence-copy small { color: var(--ink-soft, #52656a); font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-state-running .ds-sequence-rail span { animation: ds-assay-pulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite; background: var(--amber, #d87818); border-color: var(--amber, #d87818); } .ds-state-responded .ds-sequence-rail span { background: var(--green, #1f785d); border-color: var(--green, #1f785d); color: white; } .ds-state-abstained .ds-sequence-rail span { background: var(--paper-blue, #e3ebed); } .ds-state-failed .ds-sequence-rail span { background: var(--red, #a83232); border-color: var(--red, #a83232); color: white; } .ds-sequence-row:focus-within { outline: 3px solid var(--amber, #d87818); outline-offset: 3px; } @keyframes ds-assay-pulse { 0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(216, 120, 24, .15); } 50% { box-shadow: 0 5px 18px rgba(216, 120, 24, .5); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-state-running .ds-sequence-rail span { animation-duration: .01ms; animation-iteration-count: 1; } }

narrative.overview:
PocketFlow Rooms treats a multi-agent conversation as a research-laboratory observation ledger. Pale mineral surfaces, carbon ink, cobalt instruments, amber assay states, ruled registers, and numbered specimen rails make sequential evaluation tangible without imitating a conventional messenger.

The system is dense, calm, and operational. Information is separated by tonal fields and hairline rules; square controls feel like instruments; color appears only when it communicates control, identity, progress, or outcome. The transcript remains the dominant reading surface while surrounding panes expose room history and evaluation order.
keyCharacteristics: Pale mineral surfaces organized as ruled registers.
Carbon text with restrained cobalt controls and agent markers.
Amber activity, green success, and red failure states used semantically.
Square controls and containers paired with circular sequence markers.
Compact uppercase metadata supporting larger editorial headings.

rules.name: The Instrument-and-Assay Rule
rules.body: Cobalt identifies controls and agent-origin cues; amber is reserved for focus and work actively under evaluation.

rules.name: The Tonal Ledger Rule
rules.body: Separate regions with the three paper tones and hairline rules before introducing shadow.

rules.name: The One-Instrument Typeface Rule
rules.body: Use Archivo across prose, controls, labels, models, and numerals; hierarchy comes from scale, tracking, weight, and case rather than a decorative pairing.

rules.name: The Metadata Compression Rule
rules.body: Uppercase labels are compact and tracked, never used for transcript prose or long descriptions.

rules.name: The Dominant Transcript Rule
rules.body: On wide screens, preserve the complete three-pane sequence while granting flexible space to the transcript; on narrow screens, show one readable pane rather than compressing all three.

rules.name: The Flat-Bench Rule
rules.body: Surfaces remain flat at rest; use rules and paper tones for structure, reserving shadow for selection or live state.

rules.name: The Circle-Means-State Rule
rules.body: Circular geometry marks position or live status; general controls and containers stay square.

dos: Do preserve the three paper tones and ruled boundaries as the primary spatial hierarchy.
Do use cobalt for operable controls, active navigation, and agent-origin markers.
Do reserve amber for keyboard focus and the agent actively under evaluation.
Do keep transcript content readable at no more than 72ch and reveal one pane at a time below 760px.
Do keep status text explicit alongside color and maintain 44px coarse-pointer targets.
donts: Don't turn transcript entries into rounded chat bubbles or floating cards.
Don't add corner rounding to general controls, fields, panes, or register rows.
Don't use shadow as routine decoration; it signals selection, connectivity, or live evaluation.
Don't use circular geometry for general actions or containers.
Don't use color alone to communicate queued, running, passed, responded, or failed states.
